components.name: ShadMap
components.description: Map with markers from rows, on open map tiles (no API key): delivery stops and routes, field jobs and service zones, stores, sites, listings, incidents. data: rows read through latField and lngField (numbers or numeric text; rows without valid coordinates, or at exactly 0, 0, are skipped and counted in a footnote), titleField, subtitleField (a second line: the address), statusField and idField. Pins are coloured by status: by its words (Delivered or Done green, Delayed or Pending amber, Failed or Overdue red, Open, Scheduled or In transit blue; or a tone name success | warning | danger | info), or by statusColors ({ 'Under offer': '#d97706', Open: 'warning' }); showLegend (on) lists the colours with counts. labelField puts a short value in the pin (a stop number) or, longer, a price pill ('€450k'); iconField puts a lucide icon in the pin ('snowflake', 'droplets', 'zap'); markerIcon sets one icon for every pin (iconField wins per row). headingField (degrees, 0 north, clockwise) turns the icon or image to where a vehicle is going, best with 'navigation' or 'plane'. imageField shows an image per row (an https URL, a path or a data URI, SVG included; it should point north for heading) instead of the pin, with a ring of its status colour; a broken or unsafe URL keeps the pin. markerSize: small, medium (default) or large. Routes: connectMarkers draws a line through the markers in routeOrderField order, one per routeField value (a driver, a van), from routeStart (a depot { lat, lng }) when given; routes (a second dataset) draws lines from rows { name, path: [[lat, lng], ...] or a GeoJSON LineString, color or status }; routeColors names each line's colour. Areas (zones, territories, geofences): areas rows with an outline (areaShapeField: [[lat, lng], ...], a GeoJSON Polygon or its JSON text) or a circle (lat, lng and areaRadiusField in metres), titled by areaTitleField and filled by areaStatusField's tone (or the row's color). A click on a marker selects it (selectedMarker: its row, selectedMarkerId), opens a popup with the title, status and popupFields (a comma list of field specs as the Record list's metaFields: 'driver', 'eta:ETA {}', 'total|currency'; showPopup off for none) and fires onMarkerClick; a click on a line or area exposes selectedShape (its row) and selectedShapeType ('route' | 'area') and fires onShapeClicked; a click on the map clears the selection, exposes clickedLocation { lat, lng } and fires onMapClicked. pickLocation lets the user click (or drag a pin) to choose a spot: pickedLocation { lat, lng, address } and onLocationPicked (defaultPickedLocation starts it); showSearch adds an address search box (OpenStreetMap Nominatim by default, rate-limited; geocoderUrl and reverseGeocoderUrl, with {query} or {lat} and {lng}, point it at another geocoder). display 'heat' (or 'both') draws density instead of pins, weighted by heatField. clusterMarkers groups crowded pins into counts (on by default; keeps thousands of rows smooth). fitToMarkers (on by default) opens on everything drawn and refits when data changes; off, the map opens on defaultCenter ({ lat, lng }, [lat, lng] or 'lat, lng') at defaultZoom (1 to 18; 12 is a city, 15 a street). scrollWheelZoom is off by default (the page scrolls past the map; Ctrl or Cmd with the wheel zooms); showFullscreen adds a fullscreen button; mapStyle 'satellite' shows imagery and showStyleSwitch a Map | Satellite toggle. Exposes center, zoom and bounds after every move; onBoundsChange fires when the user pans or zooms. Actions: setCenter(lat, lng, zoom), setZoom, fitBounds, selectMarker(id), clearSelection, setPickedLocation(lat, lng), clearPickedLocation, setMapStyle('streets' | 'satellite'). Height: fixed (the map fills it); give it 320 to 640px

authoringHints.styles: Every style falls back to the app theme, so set only what the design needs to blend in (its accent, surfaces, borders and text colours), taking colours from the app theme or brand, never the defaults of another product. Radii and sizes are px. Styles are the way to restyle a pack widget: a cssClass only takes effect with workspace Custom styles, and Tailwind class names the pack does not already use are not compiled, so do not rely on either; for a one-off visual a style cannot express, use an Html component. Bind loadingState to the query's isLoading (each widget draws a skeleton or spinner in its own shape); tooltip shows on hover.
authoringHints.usage: Places on a map, key-free (open tiles that follow the light or dark theme): delivery stops and routes, field jobs and service zones, stores, sites, technicians, listings, incidents, in place of a table of addresses when where matters. data rows with latField and lngField (numbers or numeric text; rows without valid coordinates are skipped and counted in a footnote, so geocode addresses in the query first), titleField, subtitleField (the address), statusField and idField. Pin colours: statusField's words (Delivered or Done green, Delayed, Pending or Under offer amber, Failed, Overdue or Overloaded red, Open, Scheduled or In transit blue, Sold grey); when two states would share a colour (Open and Scheduled are both blue), set statusColors { Open: 'warning', Scheduled: 'info', Reserved: '#7c3aed' }; showLegend (on) explains the colours with counts. labelField: a stop number inside the pin (dispatch) or a price pill ('€450k'; map the rows to a formatted label first) for listings; iconField: a lucide icon per row ('snowflake', 'droplets', 'zap', 'wrench'). Routes: connectMarkers true with routeField (the driver or van: one line each, its own colour, in the legend), routeOrderField (the stop number) and routeStart (the depot { lat, lng }); or routes, a second dataset of lines { name, path: [[lat, lng], ...] or a GeoJSON LineString, status or color }; routeColors names a colour per line. Areas (service zones, territories, geofences, delivery radius): areas rows with an outline ([[lat, lng], ...], a GeoJSON Polygon or JSON text in areaShapeField) or a circle (lat, lng and a radius in metres), named by areaTitleField and filled by areaStatusField's tone (Busy amber, Overloaded red) or the row's color. popupFields lists what the popup shows under the title ('eta:ETA {}, driver, total|currency'). Wire onMarkerClick to a details sheet or a side panel from components.<map>.selectedMarker (the row) and selectedMarkerId; a list beside the map calls selectMarker(id) on its row click to bring the pin into view and open its popup. onShapeClicked with selectedShape (the route or area row) and selectedShapeType. To choose a place in a form (a new job, a new site), a ShadMap with pickLocation true and showSearch true (data '{{[]}}', defaultCenter and defaultZoom 11 on the city, fitToMarkers false, about 260px tall): the user searches an address or clicks; save components.<map>.pickedLocation.lat / .lng and .address, and react in onLocationPicked; defaultPickedLocation shows the saved spot when editing. display 'heat' (or 'both') shows density, weighted by heatField. fitToMarkers (on) opens on everything drawn and refits when data changes; off, defaultCenter at defaultZoom (12 a city, 15 a street). clusterMarkers (on) keeps thousands of rows smooth; set it off for under about 50 pins that should all show, and with numbered stops. Page scroll is never taken by the map (scrollWheelZoom off; Ctrl or Cmd with the wheel zooms); showFullscreen (on) adds a button; mapStyle 'satellite' or showStyleSwitch for site work. onBoundsChange with components.<map>.bounds { northEast, southWest } can drive a 'what is in view' query; onMapClicked exposes clickedLocation. Never put coordinates in an Html widget or an iframe map. Fixed height: 320 to 640px, a page column beside a ShadRecordList or ShadCardGrid of the same rows; not in a fit-to-content container.
